jobs.title: Leader in Asset Information  Mapping
jobs.description:
If you are committed to public service, enjoy collaborating with others, share our values and have a desire to learn and grow, join The City of Calgary. City employees deliver the services, run the programs and operate the facilities which make a difference in our community. We support work-life balance, promote physical and psychological safety, and offer competitive wages, pensions, and benefits. Together we make Calgary a great place to make a living, a great place to make a life.

The City is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and equitable workplace which is representative of the community we serve. We welcome those who have demonstrated a commitment to upholding the values of equity, diversity, inclusion, anti-racism and reconciliation. Applications are encouraged from members of groups that are historically disadvantaged and underrepresented. Accommodations are available during the hiring process, upon request.

We are seeking a strategic and forward-thinking leader to oversee integrated drafting, mapping and records management services supporting utilities geospatial asset management in Asset Information & Mapping (AIM). This role provides enterprise leadership for the creation, management, and integration of geospatial and engineering data that supports infrastructure planning, construction, operations, and emergency services across The City and with external partners. As a key member of AIM's leadership team, you will drive operational excellence, data governance, and technology modernization, ensuring high-quality, reliable geospatial and drafting services that enable data-driven decision-making and support critical public services. Primary duties include:
Lead integrated utilities related (i.e. potable water, storm, and sanitary) related mapping, drafting, design support, and records management functions, including infrastructure drawings, as-built records, and geospatial asset data integration and analysis.
Provide strategic and operational leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective service delivery aligned with City-wide standards and priorities.
Oversee the stewardship of enterprise spatial and design data that supports urban planning, utilities, public works, and emergency response.
Lead and develop a multidisciplinary technical team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Manage financial resources, staffing, and performance metrics to optimize service delivery and business outcomes.
Build and maintain strong relationships with internal clients, external partners, developers, consultants, and utility interest parties.
Champion modernization of CAD, GIS, and data management practices, leading initiatives that improve data quality, integration, and accessibility across the organization.

Qualifications

A completed 2 year Diploma in a geospatial-related program plus at least 10 years experience in an engineering graphics technology / geospatial work environment, OR
A degree in Business, Geography, Geomatics, Engineering (Civil or Municipal) or other related field with at least 8 years experience in an engineering graphics technology/geospatial mapping work environment.
Required demonstrated experience includes but is not limited to:
At least 5 years of progressively more responsible leadership assignments which include supervisory roles managing technical staff
Asset management experience: spatial data acquisition, design and integration experience.
Success in this position requires experience with GIS, CAD and other geospatial asset management and drafting systems, asset management: spatial data acquisition, design and integration, land and infrastructure development and experience in the public sector.
You have strong political acumen, analytical skills, superior communication skills and the ability to create and execute a strategic vision and direction.
You will have demonstrated success in building, developing and leading strong teams, leading and managing change, and establishing and maintaining strong and positive working relationships.
Equivalent combinations of experience and education may be considered.

Pre-employment Requirements

Successful applicants must provide proof of qualifications.

Workstyle

This position may be eligible to work from home for at least part of the time as one of several flexible work options available to City employees. These arrangements depend on the operational requirements of the role, employee suitability, and are subject to change based on operational needs and corporate direction.

jobs.title: Directeur Financier | Finance Director
jobs.description:
Description

Qui sommes-nous : Manos

Manos Software Group fait partie de Valsoft Corporation, un investisseur à long terme dans les entreprises de logiciels de marchés verticaux. Valsoft acquiert et exploite des sociétés de logiciels avec une vision de détention permanente, en mettant l’accent sur l’autonomie, une croissance disciplinée et la création de valeur à long terme. Manos se concentre sur des secteurs connexes à la santé, notamment les logiciels dentaires, médicaux et vétérinaires.

Description Du Poste

Dans le cadre de l’expansion continue de notre portefeuille d’entreprises de logiciels spécialisés par secteur d’activité, nous recherchons une personne dynamique et expérimentée pour rejoindre notre équipe en tant que Directeur.trice Financier·ère. Relevant directement de l’un des Partenaires d’Investissement, la personne retenue sera responsable de la supervision de la performance financière et du développement stratégique de notre portefeuille. Ce rôle implique une prise en charge complète de la planification financière, du reporting et de la gestion de la performance.

La personne idéale est un.e leader stratégique doté.e d’une forte expertise financière, capable de favoriser l’excellence opérationnelle, d’optimiser la rentabilité et d’assurer un flux de trésorerie positif. Cette personne travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, en favorisant la coopération pour exécuter avec succès les stratégies d’entreprise tout en maintenant des contrôles financiers rigoureux et une conformité exemplaire.

Responsabilités principales

Piloter la planification financière en analysant la performance et les risques du portefeuille
Définir les objectifs et superviser l’ensemble du personnel comptable et financier (comptabilité, FP&A, comptes clients, comptes fournisseurs)
Préparer les rapports financiers mensuels, trimestriels et annuels
Élaborer et gérer les prévisions financières mensuelles, trimestrielles et annuelles ; suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPIs)
Surveiller et analyser les performances pour identifier des axes d’amélioration et mettre en œuvre des plans d’action permettant d’atteindre ou de dépasser les objectifs financiers
Suivre la santé financière du portefeuille et garantir un flux de trésorerie positif
Diriger et organiser les audits légaux annuels, en veillant au respect de toutes les obligations réglementaires
Développer des stratégies pour améliorer la rentabilité et le retour sur investissement
Superviser et réviser les activités comptables, y compris la fiscalité et la conformité
Veiller à l’efficacité des contrôles financiers internes et évaluer en continu les politiques et procédures en place
Collaborer avec l’équipe chargée de l’intégration des entreprises nouvellement acquises, notamment pour la production des bilans d’ouverture, des états financiers complets, et pour assurer leur intégration aux processus financiers de Valsoft
Maintenir une communication régulière avec le département Finance du groupe
Participer activement aux processus d’acquisition et de cession d’entreprises
Accomplir toutes autres responsabilités confiées par l’employeur, que la personne s’engage à exécuter avec diligence, conformément aux termes de l’accord

Prêt(e) à joindre une équipe collaborative et innovante où vous pourrez avoir un impact immédiat?

#Manos

Manos Overview

Manos Software Group is part of Valsoft Corporation, a long-term investor in vertical market software businesses. Valsoft acquires and operates software companies with a permanent ownership mindset, emphasizing autonomy, disciplined growth, and long-term value creation. Manos focuses on healthcare-adjacent verticals, including dental, medical, and veterinary software.

Position Description

As we continue to expand our portfolio of vertical market software businesses, we are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team as Finance Director. Reporting directly to one of our Investment Partners, the Finance Director will be responsible for overseeing the financial performance and strategic development of our portfolio. This role involves full ownership and accountability for financial planning, reporting, and performance management. The ideal candidate is a strategic leader with a strong financial acumen, capable of driving operational excellence, optimizing profitability, and ensuring positive cash flow. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, fostering collaboration to execute business strategies successfully while maintaining rigorous financial controls and compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the financial planning of the company by analyzing portfolio performance and risks
Set targets for and supervise all accounting and finance personnel (Accounting, FP&A, AR, AP)
Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
Build and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts; track KPIs
Monitor and analyze performance strategies to identify areas of opportunity and implement action plans to meet or exceed financial targets
Monitor the financial health of the portfolio and ensure positive cash flow
Lead and organize annual statutory audits and ensure all required filings are completed
Develop strategies to increase return on investment and profitability
Oversee and review accounting tasks, including tax and compliance
Ensure effective financial internal controls and continuously evaluate established policies and procedures
Collaborate with the integration team of newly acquired companies by producing opening balances, complete financials, and onboarding on Valsoft finance procedures
Maintain high-level interaction with the corporate finance department
Actively participate in processes related to the sale or acquisition of companies
Perform all other applicable responsibilities as delegated by the Employer, which the Employee agrees to carry out diligently under the terms of the Agreement

Ready to join a collaborative and innovative team where you can make an immediate impact?

#Manos

jobs.title: Senior Director, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Our Company Background & Culture

UPP is the first pension plan of its kind in Ontario’s university sector, proudly serving over 46,000 members across six universities and nineteen sector organizations. Our purpose is to bring greater retirement peace of mind to the university sector by investing with integrity and serving members with care. As a sector-wide plan designed for growth, our doors are open to all Ontario universities.
UPP is recognized as one of Greater Toronto’s Top Employers for 2026. Together, we’re a team of progressive thinkers and agile doers operating within a fast-paced culture of collaboration and respect. We believe in bringing smart and capable people together to create, solve, and grow with a clear shared vision and values of integrity, inclusivity, ingenuity, and impact.
Our culture is intentionally welcoming and purposefully rooted in equity, diversity, inclusion, and reconciliation (EDI&R). We believe diverse teams, perspectives, and lived experiences contribute to better decisions and a better workplace.
As a pension plan, UPP approaches investing through a long-term lens to generate and safeguard value. Our commitment to investing responsibly accounts for material risks that impact our investment portfolio to generate sufficient risk-adjusted returns to meet the pension needs of our members.
Join us in building a bright future for our members, our organization, and each other.
THE ROLE

We are seeking a forward-looking Senior Director, Data & Analytics to lead and evolve UPP’s enterprise data capabilities. Reporting to the Managing Director, Data and Technology, this role will work with business and technology leaders to improve how data is governed, integrated, managed and used across UPP. Its scope includes data in UPP’s enterprise data hub and across the broader cloud solutions ecosystem, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP). The Senior Director will help ensure data is trusted, accessible and fit for business reporting, analytics, automation and emerging AI workloads.
This is an opportunity for an experienced data leader to shape an important enterprise capability and help UPP make better use of its data as the organization grows.
This role is based in downtown Toronto under a hybrid work policy, allowing employees the flexibility to work remotely and in-office (two days per week in-office).
This posting is for an existing vacancy.
Specific Accountabilities

The Senior Director, Data & Analytics will lead and evolve UPP’s data capabilities, including the following:
Develop and evolve UPP’s enterprise data strategy and practices so data is well governed, reliable, discoverable and useful across the organization.
Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for data quality, data engineering, data integration, data operations and analytics enablement.
Establish data standards and practices in partnership with business data owners, Architecture, Cybersecurity and other technology teams.
Guide the use of cloud-based data capabilities, including GCP, to support reliable data integration, reporting and analytics. Improve data quality, access, lineage and governance so data is ready for responsible automation and AI workloads, in partnership with the teams accountable for AI platforms, architecture, privacy and cybersecurity.
Partner with business and technology leaders to prioritize data needs and enable trusted, data-informed decisions. Establish the access patterns, tools, standards, training and controls that allow business users, including citizen data users, to work with data safely and at scale.
Improve the reliability, quality, reuse and maintainability of data integration and transformation flows that support key processes, including pension data conversion, regular employer reporting, and Finance reporting and analysis.
Leverage leading frameworks (such as DCAM) to continually mature and evolve the data strategy and frequently self-asses the capabilities for progress
Define and communicate data priorities, target capabilities and roadmaps, aligning plans with enterprise needs and available capacity.
Research and establish peer connections to understand industry trends and their applicability to support data plans and strategies for the enterprise
Explain the value of trusted data and sound data management practices to technical and non-technical audiences.
Oversee UPP’s data catalog and related metadata practices, working with Architecture and data owners to improve data discoverability and stewardship.
Contribute to UPP’s reputation as a respectful employer, partner, and participant in the financial sector

Qualifications & Experience

10+ years of demonstrated experience developing and leading enterprise data capabilities, including data governance, data engineering, integration, data operations and analytics.
CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional) or an equivalent qualification is an asset.
Significant progressive experience in data management, including data governance, architecture, integration, data quality, metadata and analytics.
Experience leading data teams or capabilities in a cloud-based environment, with sufficient technical understanding of data platforms, databases, integration and transformation tools, analytics and visualization to set direction and make informed decisions. Experience with GCP or comparable cloud data platforms is an asset.
Understanding of relational and non-relational data and the considerations involved in integrating and governing different data types.
Experience working across complex business domains; experience in pensions, investments or financial services is an asset.
Experience designing and evolving cloud-based data capabilities in partnership with internal teams and external service providers.
Working knowledge of analytics methods and the interpretation of quantitative information.

ATTRIBUTES

Excellent written and verbal communications
Ability to design and improve repeatable data practices
Ability to drive outcomes through collaboration across teams and contributors
Ability to engage and align business users, data owners and technology partners.
Ability to effectively identify emerging technologies, trends, standards, and products that have a strong potential to better enable UPP business units
Ability to enable consistent, governed data use at scale.

LIFE AT UPP

Do work that matters.
We are duty-bound to serve our members’ interests, and it’s a responsibility we don’t take lightly. That’s why we’ve ingrained sustainability in our work from day one—to ensure our members have a resilient future to retire into, both today and for generations to come.
Stronger together.
Collaboration is how UPP was born, and it’s how we work with each other and our partners day in, day out. No one at UPP is just a number (even if they are excellent at math) and every win is a shared win.
Grow every day.
You’ll have the opportunity to work on unique, once-in-a-career projects that maximize your skill set and probably teach you some new ones—at any stage in your career.
Prioritize wellness.
At UPP, wellness takes many forms. Ultimately, it’s about ensuring our people are cared for in the ways that matter to them. Check out some highlights of our inclusive employee-focused benefits program including:
Defined benefit pension plan
Flexible hybrid work model
Paid time off – vacations, personal days and wellness days
Work remotely up to eight weeks/year
Comprehensive group benefits including medical, dental, vision, etc.
Extended paramedical and mental health service coverage
Health care and lifestyle spending accounts
Fertility treatments, paid parental leave, and gender affirmation coverage
Education Assistance program

This posting will remain open for a minimum of seven (7) days and will remain open until a sufficient number of qualified applications are received or finalist candidates have been identified.
Artificial intelligence (AI) tools may be used to support certain stages of the recruitment process, including sourcing, screening, and assessment. All hiring decisions involve human review and intervention by UPP employees.
UPP enthusiastically welcomes applications from all qualified applicants and especially invites people with lived experience as an Indigenous person, a person with a disability or as a member of another Human Rights Code protected group that faces barriers to employment to apply. Our goal is to create a barrier-free experience for every candidate throughout the recruitment process.

UPP respects your privacy. For information on how UPP handles the personal information you provide during the application process, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Statement.
